name: pi-process-tree
description: A zero-dependency TypeScript library that tracks a process tree by (pid, start time) identity and reaps runaways.

scripts.build: node -e "const m=require('node:module'),fs=require('fs');fs.writeFileSync('process-tree.js','// Generated from process-tree.ts by node:module stripTypeScriptTypes; edit the .ts file.\n'+m.stripTypeScriptTypes(fs.readFileSync('process-tree.ts','utf8'),{mode:'strip'}))"

author: El Fenomeno
